exposure: type of sFGR (type I, II, III)
outcome: type of cord insertions (concordant, intermediate, discordant)
type and size of placental vascular anastomoses (AA anastomoses)
cohort: The study included placentas from 813 monochorionic twin pregnancies, both with and without selective fetal growth restriction, excluding those with twin-twin transfusion syndrome, twin anemia polycythemia sequence, and monoamnionicity.
finding: sFGR type III placentas exhibit a high prevalence of proximate cord insertion (PCI) and are associated with larger arterio-arterial (AA) anastomoses and a potentially higher risk of fetal demise.
